title: Peak Hours Triage Protocol
content: During peak operational hours (7pm–11pm IST), the Kirana Cloud on-call team MUST always roll back recent deployments first and perform root-cause analysis later. Speed of recovery takes precedence over diagnosing live bug state.

title: Ledger Database Safeguard
content: Never restart the ledger-db primary or execute failovers without explicitly paging Priya Raman (Database Owner) first, regardless of severity level.

title: Payment Incident Status Page SLA
content: Payment worker or UPI settlement incidents lasting longer than 10 minutes require an immediate external status page update (status.kiranacloud.in) within 15 minutes.

title: Redis Memory Incident Action
content: When dealing with Redis maxmemory or key eviction on checkout-api, NEVER perform a full FLUSHALL command. Always run targeted pattern-based expiration scripts to preserve live customer carts.

title: Kafka Consumer Lag Scaling Rule
content: Do NOT scale out search-indexer pods during active Kafka rebalance storms. Scaling out dynamic consumers triggers additional rebalance loops. Ensure group.instance.id is pinned.

title: UPI Retry Feature Flag Safety
content: Before enabling any payment retry or UPI workflow feature flags, verify idempotency headers on payment callbacks and consult Arjun Mehta (Payments Tech Lead).
